description: Checks local-only skill discovery and evidence-grounded matching.

evals.label: Return exact local skill identifiers and paths
evals.prompt: Find the repository skill relevant to inspecting WNTR hydraulic simulation results.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports relevant local skills by exact frontmatter ID and path, with reasons grounded in their descriptions and scope.
assertions: Each recommended skill has an exact ID and repository-relative path.
Relevance reasons are based on the skill text rather than popularity.

evals.label: Report when the local collection has no match
evals.prompt: Find a repository-local skill that installs a licensed GIS application and automates its desktop UI.
evals.expected_output: The agent says no repository-local match was found and does not claim to search external registries or install anything.
assertions: The agent limits discovery to the repository-local skill collection.
The agent does not install a skill or produce an execution plan.
